primary_unit: one target rubric criterion per new textual attempt; paired profiles are repeated observations
reviewer_fixture: rubric-scoped-max.v1 (maximal score, select claims by criterion policy, no gold or grader input)

metrics.criterion_precision: TP/(TP+FP), positive credit vs gold>0; null counts as no validated positive
metrics.criterion_recall: TP/(TP+FN), null counts as missed positive
metrics.false_credit: score>gold, all eligible; null separately reported
metrics.missed_credit: score<gold, all eligible; null separately reported
metrics.point_MAE: mean abs(score-gold) per criterion, scores on /4; G1 defined-only with availability
metrics.unsafe_automation: automated G2 with any score error or benchmark requires-review / automated; null if none
metrics.comparison: paired absolute error: better/worse/tie; report raw signed shifts, recovery and new false credit

gate.substitution: under-credit decreases and no new false credit vs baseline; do not advance otherwise
gate.method: under-credit decreases and no new false credit vs substitution-only
gate.final: >=25% fewer missed criteria in primary G0 and G2; no increase in false-credit count or over-credit points; zero new material unsafe automation

exclusions: Only predeclared BENCHMARK_ADJUDICATION_REQUIRED excluded from numeric metrics; coverage boundaries reported separately and in all-unambiguous totals
anti_leakage: Do not execute or modify HOLDOUT_V1. New cases never claim independent post-fix validation. No HOLDOUT_V2 cases authored here.
